v0_2_0_optional_samples: Added guided English/Japanese installers for Windows, macOS and Linux, with optional fictional sample data for evaluation.
v0_2_0_consolidated_initialization: Improved updates and restores for existing installations with verified backups and encryption key checks.
v0_2_0_development_notice: Version 0.2.0 is a development release. Features, data structures, and upgrade procedures may change before version 1.0.0.
v0_2_0_dashboard_pdf_export: Added an employee dashboard for headcount, age groups and turnover, with PDF export of summaries and charts.
v0_2_0_localization: Added English/Japanese display across major pages, shared navigation and master management.
v0_2_0_it_asset_credentials: Added IT asset network details and encrypted password management, including a Server Administrator role and reauthentication before password display.
v0_2_0_employee_visibility: Added options to include retired and deleted employees in lists and CSV exports, with read-only details for deleted employees.
v0_1_0_system_information: Added product version, release notice, public repository, and revision history information to System settings.
v0_1_0_backup_and_recovery: Added verified full-database backup, update, and disaster-recovery tools for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
v0_1_0_role_management: Added role name management and replaced editable role codes with immutable permission identifiers.
v0_1_0_work_calendars: Improved Work calendars with automatic public-holiday imports and responsive employee assignment controls.
v0_1_0_employee_name_formatting: Added language-aware employee name formatting and localized gender and length-of-service labels.
v0_1_0_employee_email_and_asset_notes: Added employee email actions and made IT asset notes easier to identify.
v0_1_0_responsive_layouts: Improved responsive layouts across Settings, System settings, master data, and asset management screens.
v0_1_0_active_data_transfer: Added a separate active-data export and restore workflow that preserves database date values without time-zone shifts.
